programme.title: Guardiãs Do Túmulo
programme.desc: Numa missão de salvamento do irmão, Jia descobre o túmulo subterrâneo de um antigo imperador chinês, que viveu uma vida estranhamente longa 200 anos antes de Cristo, só que rapidamente percebe que desenterrou também um segredo que devia ter ficado para sempre soterrado.

programme.title: The Contractor: Mercenário
programme.desc: Após ser dispensado das Forças Especiais do Exército e perder a pensão e o seguro de saúde, James Harper, endividado e com a família para sustentar, assina contrato com a uma equipa militar privada. Só que quando primeira missão corre mal, ele torna-se um alvo a abater.

programme.title: The Loveless
programme.desc: Numa pequena cidade do sul dos EUA, um gangue de motoqueiros envolve-se em problemas enquanto se dirige para as corridas em Daytona.

programme.title: Órfã: A Origem
programme.desc: Depois de planear uma brilhante fuga de um hospital psiquiátrico na Estónia, Esther viaja até aos EUA passando-se pela filha desaparecida de uma família milionária. No entanto, após uma inesperada reviravolta, a mãe começa a desconfiar da “criança” assassina, e tudo faz para proteger a sua família.

programme.title: Como Matar E Ganhar
programme.desc: Após um acidente de viação fatal, Michel foge do local e quando lá regressa com a mulher para tentar encobrir o incidente e esconder as vítimas, encontra dois milhões de euros num saco, o que dá origem a uma série de acontecimentos caóticos.

programme.title: Viagem À Juventude
programme.desc: Brian aceitar levar o seu sogro deprimido de 80 anos até Oregon, onde a eutanásia é legal, só que ao longo do caminho vai ajudá-lo a redescobrir uma razão para viver.

programme.title: Romance And Cigarros
programme.desc: Nick é um metalúrgico de Nova Iorque casado com Kitty mas que mantém um caso em segredo a escaldante Tula. Quando a traição é descoberta, ele terá de encontrar rapidamente uma forma de reconquistar a família, correndo o risco de chegar demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Praxx Fim De Semana
programme.desc: Inverno, sexta-feira. Um grupo de jovens universitários parte para um fim de semana em São João da Cruz, para celebrar a sua ascensão na prestigiada Associação da Vida Académica. A diversão dos jovens acaba por dar lugar ao terror quando à noite, na Praia da Cruz, um ritual de praxe é levado ao limite.

programme.title: True Justice: Ações Violentas
programme.desc: Enquanto investiga o desaparecimento de uma carrinha de segurança que transportava 20 milhões de dólares, o antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane vai enfrentar um perigoso mafioso, uma organização misteriosa chamada Quicksilver e uma figura do passado que ele e a CIA julgavam morta.

programme.title: True Justice: Anjo da Morte
programme.desc: O antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane enfrenta terroristas que tentam traficar bombas nucleares em malas de viagem, desconfiando que é o seu maior inimigo quem está a tentar apanhá-las.

programme.title: Covil De Ladrões
programme.desc: A unidade de elite de combate ao crime de Los Angeles, que nem sempre joga pelas regras, entra em confronto com o gangue de assalto a bancos mais bem sucedido da cidade. Quando os fora-da-lei decidem assaltar a Reserva Federal, qual dos dois se revelará o mais implacável?

programme.title: O Coletivo
programme.desc: Um jovem recruta para uma misteriosa agência de assassinos torna-se um pária na sua primeira missão, rastreando um perigoso grupo de traficantes de pessoas.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: O arqueólogo Daniel Jackson descobre como fazer funcionar um portal estelar descoberto debaixo de uma pirâmide. O coronel Jonathan ´Jack´ O´Neil recebe a missão de acompanhar Jackson e uma pequena equipa de soldados americanos através do stargate para explorar a galáxia desconhecida do outro lado.

programme.title: Os Perdedores
programme.desc: Um grupo de agentes especiais da CIA é traído pelos seus superiores e abandonado à morte certa. Contra todas as expectativas, os operacionais voltam a juntar-se para se vingarem de quem os deixou ficar para trás.

programme.title: Safe - O Intocável
programme.desc: Mei é uma jovem de memória prodigiosa que tem na cabeça um código numérico que a leva a ser perseguia pelas tríades chinesas, a máfia russa e polícias corruptos de Nova Iorque. Em seu auxílio surge um ex-polícia caído em desgraça que não se vai deter perante nada para a proteger..

programme.title: O Capanga: Vingança
programme.desc: Pat Tate lança-se numa cruzada para vingar a morte violenta do seu amigo durante um assalto, mergulhando no lado negro do Soho nos anos 90.

programme.title: Coriolano
programme.desc: Caius Martius ´Coriolano´, um temido general romano, está em conflito com a cidade de Roma e com os seus concidadãos, e alia-se ao seu jurado inimigo Tullus Aufidius para se vingar.

programme.title: Bolero
programme.desc: A audaciosa dançarina Ida Rubinstein escolhe o compositor Maurice Ravel para compor a música para o seu próximo bailado, e ele acaba por criar o maior sucesso a carreira de ambos: “Bolero”.

programme.title: Medida Provisória
programme.desc: Num futuro distópico, o governo brasileiro decreta uma medida provisória que obriga os cidadãos negros a “regressarem” a África, como forma de reparar os erros cometidos na era da escravatura, o que provoca o caos, protestos e um movimento de resistência que vai inspirar a nação.

programme.title: Diário De Um Romance Passageiro
programme.desc: Uma mãe solteira e um homem casado encontram-se por diversão, sabendo que a sua relação não tem futuro e que não se apaixonarão. Contudo, tudo se vai complicar entre ambos, quando afinal os sentimentos mais fortes começam a surgir.

programme.title: Assim Nasce Uma Estrela
programme.desc: Ester Blodgett é uma jovem cantora que ascende ao estrelato em Hollywood graças ao apoio de Norman Maine, um ator famoso por quem ela se apaixona, que por sua vez se está a afundar no alcoolismo e no esquecimento.

programme.title: True Justice: A Hora de Morrer
programme.desc: A busca pelas malas de viagem com bombas nucleares continua mas agora o antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane suspeita que o seu contacto na CIA esteja a trabalhar contra ele.

programme.title: True Justice: O Fantasma
programme.desc: O antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane está cada vez mais perto do inimigo que todos procuram, o Fantasma, mas quando tudo se parece encaminhar para o fim, o FBI começa a investigar o próprio Kane e os seus métodos de investigação menos convencionais e tudo se complica ainda mais.

programme.title: O Melhor Homem
programme.desc: Um grupo de mercenários toma o controlo do hotel de um resort remoto durante um casamento e cabe ao padrinho, ao noivo e ao seu melhor amigo bêbado tentarem deter os terroristas e salvar os reféns.

programme.title: Preto Ou Branco
programme.desc: Elliott Anderson, recentemente viúvo, fica responsável por cuidar da neta mas é levado a tribunal pela avó paterna, que quer obter a custódia da criança, obrigando as duas famílias a confrontarem-se com os medos e convicções mais profundos no que respeita a raça, perdão e compreensão.

programme.title: Os Empatas
programme.desc: Quando três pais ficam a saber que as suas filhas fizeram um pacto entre si para perderem a virgindade no baile de finalistas, eles iniciam uma missão secreta para boicotarem os seus planos.

programme.title: Chefes Intragáveis
programme.desc: Para Nick, Kurt e Dale, a única coisa que tornaria os seus empregos mais toleráveis seria verem cada um dos seus chefes transformados em poeira. Com umas bebidas a mais e com os conselhos de um ex-prisioneiro, os três amigos concebem um plano para se livrarem dos seus patrões... para sempre.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Num futuro não muito distante, em que as calotas polares derreteram e a maioria do planeta está debaixo de água, um marinheiro mutante luta contra a fome e os fora-da-lei, e acaba a contragosto por aceitar ajudar uma mulher e uma menina a encontrarem terra firme.

programme.title: Força Em Alerta 2
programme.desc: Casey Ryback parte de férias com a sobrinha num comboio do Colorado a Los Angeles, só que, logo no início da viagem, um grupo de terroristas invade o veiculo para usá-lo como quartel general na captura de um satélite altamente secreto e extraordinariamente destrutivo.

programme.title: É Só Querer
programme.desc: Após uma vida de estudo, um professor universitário, um explicador e um desempregado continuam sem dinheiro. A solução para os seus problemas pode estar num comprimido, que um deles criou, e que é uma droga que dá uma grande energia mas sem ressaca!

programme.title: Triple Concerto, Op. 56 And Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. Beethoven's Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Piano in C major, commonly known as the Triple Concerto, was composed from 1803 to 1804.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Beethoven No. 5
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed.

programme.title: Boulez conducts Mahler's Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Pierre Boulez conducts the orchestra and choirs of the Berlin State Opera and the orchestra of the Staatskapelle Berlin in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2. This concert is part of a series of events celebrating the French conductor and composer's 80th birthday. With his uncompromising approach to the score, Boulez's Mahler readings have long fascinated critics and audiences alike.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 12, K 414
programme.desc: Vladimir Ashkenazy performs as a soloist and conductor in Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 12, K 414. He is accompanied by the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra at the Hampton Court Palace, London.

programme.title: Rota - The Godfather Suite
programme.desc: This exclusive live concert production presents a unique selection of movie classics - from Sergio Leone’s iconic Spaghetti Westerns to modern mafia masterpieces by Francis Ford Coppola and the cult movies of Tarantino. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir are conducted by Sarah Hicks in this premiere performance of authentic soundtracks by composer legends Ennio Morricone, Nino Rota, Sonny Bono and Bernard Herrmann.

programme.title: Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach.

programme.title: Strauss - Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Violinist Daniel Rowland, violist Rachel Roberts, cellist Julian Arp, and pianist Diana Ketler perform Richard Strauss’s Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13, as part of the Stiftfestival 2016 in the Dutch village of Weerselo. In his early years, Strauss tried to compose different types of chamber music works, including a piano quartet.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes at the Zurich Opera House
programme.desc: The Zurich Opera House is one of the most renowned in Europe. Fifteen premieres are staged here every year - a significant achievement, when one considers just how much work goes into each individual production.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Works for cello and fortepiano by Beethoven
programme.desc: Every year in late August, the renowned Early Music Festival takes place in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is the world's largest festival focused on early music, attracting an audience of over 70 thousand visitors. Due to the corona pandemic, the 2020 edition of the festival took place in an alternative form, offering an alternative program that included live concerts as well as daily livestreams of concerts and archive recordings.

programme.title: Soulscapes
programme.desc: In retrospect, the version for solo dance of Stravinsky’s Sacre du printemps can be interpreted as a bleak, oppressive dance about his own life. The ballet is one of the late works by Uwe Scholz, one of the most important choreographers of the twentieth century. During his short life, this wunderkind created over 100 ballets, including major stage successes such as Die Schöpfung, Die Grosse Messe and Bruckner 8.

programme.title: Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire.

programme.title: Bach – Italian Concerto And Chaconne (arr. Busoni)
programme.desc: Italian classical pianist Costanza Principe (1993) started playing the piano at age 6, making her public debut at age 7. Before long she would be performing as a soloist with numerous prestigious orchestras in Italy, the UK, France, and South America.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 94, Hob. I:94
programme.desc: Joseph Haydn (1732-1809): Symphony No. 94 in G major 'Surprise'. Berliner Philharmoniker; conductor: Mariss Jansons. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991. The musicians commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra's founding on May 1st, 1882, playing in different European cities. This concert was recorded in the church 'Hagia Eirene' in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. Its musical director is Jeanne Lamon. Together with the Trio Arabica they celebrate the music and culture in the eighteenth century.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major, K. 216. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Swan Lake (2015)
programme.desc: The Imperial Ice Stars are an ensemble of 24 world class skaters, holding more than 300 competition medals between them. Praised by critics and audiences alike, they never fail to enchant with creative and powerful story-telling, sumptuous sets, spectacular special effects and opulent costumes.

programme.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists
programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. Founded in 1947 by Monza-born pianist Rina Sala Gallo and Brescia-born pianist Arturo Benedetti Michelangeli, the competition is one of Monza’s most prestigious cultural events today.

programme.title: Le Grand Orgue in Concert
programme.desc: Current holder of “Great Organ of the Notre Dame,” Olivier Latry began his musical career when he enrolled in Gaston Litaize’s organ class at the Academy of Saint-Maur at the age of 16. In 1985, at 23 years of age, Latry was awarded the post of one of four “titulaires des grands orgues” of Notre Dame, Paris.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker is one of the best known and most beloved pieces from the composer. The music has inspired many choreographers to the tell the colourful Christmas fairy-tale of E. T. A. Hoffmann and Alexandre Dumas senior in the language of dance. Ben Stevenson is to this day considered one of the most important influencers of the American ballet art.

programme.title: Beethoven - Triple Concerto, Op. 56
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello).

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 3, Op. 108
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition.

programme.title: Schubert - Symphony No. 8 in B minor, D. 759
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance Les Dissonances perform Franz Schubert’s Symphony No. 8 in B minor, D. 759, also known as the ‘Unfinished Symphony’.

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 7, Op. 70
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Antonín Dvorák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. The work was completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvorák’s broader oeuvre.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2000 from Berlin
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev (piano), Karita Mattila (soprano), Violeta Urmana (alto), Thomas Moser (tenor), Eike Wilm Schulte (bass), Swedish Radio Choir, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir, Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, conductor: Claudio Abbado. Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Piano Concerto No. 2 in B flat major, Op. 19 - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991.

programme.title: Summertime at the Domaine Forget
programme.desc: The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. Domaine Forget is one of Canada's leading music academies and hosts this annual festival to promote music and dance.

programme.title: Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). L’elisir d’amore is perhaps the most famous work in Donizetti’s extensive repertoire. It tells the story of the poor peasant Nemorino who is in love with the beautiful landowner Adina.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final: Beethoven and Liszt
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 36, K. 425
programme.desc: Jeffrey Tate conducts the English Chamber Orchestra in a performance of W. A. Mozart’s “Linzer” Symphony No. 36 (K. 425). The broadcast is directed by János Darvas. Mozart composed the work in 1783, during his short stay in the Austrian town of Linz, on the way home from Vienna to Salzburg. The symphony was written in an impressive span of only four days to accommodate a local concert.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 And Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Brahms - Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in a wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, violinist Tedi Papavrami, violist Lyda Chen-Argerich, cellist Mischa Maisky, and pianist Lily Maisky perform Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Concerto for Orchestra
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Bela Bartok’s ‘Concerto for Orchestra’ is discussed.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 31, Op. 110
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: My heart is burning
programme.desc: René Pape perfectly embodies the new generation of opera singers: with a current and relaxed appearance, he craves new challenges and demonstrates an openness to ambitious experimentation. In the musical film My Heart Is Burning, René Pape sings and plays various roles that showcase the impressive versatility of his voice and the many facets of his personality. Directed by Sibylle Muth.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 4 BWV 1017
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 1 BWV 1014 is the fourth out of the set of sonatas Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022. Having completed a number of shorter orchestral works, Tchaikovsky embarked on a more ambitious project in March 1866: to write his first symphony.

programme.title: Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas
programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange au Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Preludes and fugues
programme.desc: Compagnia Simona Bucci presents an extraordinary concert in scenic form: 'Preludi e Fughe - Geografia antropica'. Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87 inspired choreographer Simona Bucci to take on this project. Seven dancers of Compagnia Simona Bucci dance to Shostakovich’s Preludes and Fugues Nos. 1, 5, 7, 12, 13, 14, 16 and 24, played by Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda.

programme.title: Liszt Mosaics: Dance Concert
programme.desc: This concert entitled 'Liszt Mosaics' is dedicated to the rich traditonal of Hungarian Folk Music. The concert opens with a selection of Bartók's 44 Duos for 2 Violins (No. 17, 18 and 36) performed by Shlomo Mintz and Radics Ferenc. Furthermore, Pál Eszter is accompanied by the Hungarian State Folk Ensemble and Cameristi della Scala in vocal performances of Hungarian Folk Music from the Kalotaszeg region.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Bruckner's Fifth Symphony has been called the 'Medieval' because of its multi-layered, Baroque, contrapuntal tonal textures and the 'Catholic' because of its solemn majesty. These designations are uniquely fitting to the work, Bruckner himself called it his 'Fantastic,' especially when it is performed at the Monastery of St. Florian, as on this recording.

programme.title: Antonio Manna: Il basso napolitano
programme.desc: Stefano Demicheli conducts the Ensemble Talenti Vulcanici and soloists Nicola Cianncio (bass) and Catherine Jones (cello) in a varied baroque music program, recorded at Chiesa di Santa Caterina da Seina in Naples, Italy.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 30, Op. 109
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends.

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 6 in D major
programme.desc: For the 2016 edition of the Waldbühne, the Georgian violinist Lisa Batiashvili and the Québécois conductor Yannick Nézet-Séguin join the Berliner Philharmoniker for a beautiful concert. They present an all Czech program!

programme.title: Jerusalem International Chamber Music Festival
programme.desc: Having achieved incredible success with consistently sold-out concerts, the Jerusalem International Chamber Music Festival is renowned for its exceptional repertoire of performances by top soloists who otherwise seldom share a stage. This program presents highlights of the 2008 edition, of which the theme centered on the exploration of the “national spirit” of music.

programme.title: Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging piece. This performance was recorded at St.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Karita Mattila (soprano), Violeta Urmana (alto), Thomas Moser (tenor), Eike Wilm Schulte (bass), Swedish Radio Choir, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir, Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, conductor: Claudio Abbado. Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991.

programme.title: Galaxymphony Strikes Back
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music.

programme.title: Bellini/Liszt - Réminiscences de Norma S.394
programme.desc: Minsoo Hong (1993, South Korea) performs Liszt’s Sposalizio from Années de Pèlerinage: Deuxième Année (S161/1) and Bellini/Liszt’s Réminiscences de Norma (S394) during the Solo Finals of the11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world.

programme.title: Verdi - Rigoletto
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s tragic opera Rigoletto (1851). In 1850, Teatro La Fenice commissioned Verdi to compose a new opera. Verdi proposed Victor Hugo’s controversial play Le Roi s'amuse to his librettist Francesco Maria Piave.

programme.title: Europakonzert 1993 - Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: England, my England - II
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht was all about 'England, my England'. In line with this theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer on an intriguing journey through the England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. This performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Intercidades
programme.desc: O Intercidades é a viagem regional de fim de tarde do Conta Lá, conduzida por Rita Ferro Rodrigues, em estúdio, e uma vasta equipa de repórteres sempre em movimento pelas regiões. O programa distingue-se pelo olhar atento ao país, ligando estúdio e território em tempo real. O comboio vai parar nos vários concelhos e levar-nos até quem faz cada localidade — do café à escola, do campo à praça.

programme.desc: “Ultraje” é uma viagem vibrante pelo coração da identidade portuguesa. Em cada episódio, percorremos o país para descobrir os trajes típicos que contam histórias de outras gerações, mergulhando nas tradições, costumes e festas que lhes dão vida. Mais do que roupa, são símbolos de orgulho, resistência e pertença — preservados por homens e mulheres que mantêm viva a memória coletiva.

programme.title: Documentário: Chefe Do Ano 2026
programme.desc: Há 36 anos que a mesma pergunta atravessa as cozinhas de Portugal: quem é o Chefe do Ano? Mais do que um concurso, é o palco onde um sonho se transforma em legado, o mesmo que revelou nomes hoje incontornáveis na gastronomia portuguesa, todos eles, um dia, apenas cozinheiros e cozinheiras com uma faca, uma ideia e a coragem de arriscar tudo.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 67
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 105
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 49
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 106
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Meu Campeão - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 68
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Mike Stern And Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat And Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation.

programme.title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’.

programme.title: Tania Maria Trio - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins live in Belgium, 1962
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report’s “Birdland” that opens the performance to the final notes of “Gonna Fly Now” that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine.

programme.title: Paï
programme.desc: Recorded in 1971 in Paris, France, Brazilian, classically trained bossa nova guitarist Baden Powell and his quartet play Pai, Lotus (written by Baden Powell), Tristeza (by Haroldo Lobo/Niltinho), Round Midnight (by Thelonious Monk), Nega do cabelo duro (by David Nasser/Rubens Soares), and Aos pes da cruz (by Zé da Zilda/Marino Pinto).

programme.title: Weird Fishes
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. One of them is Dutch singer, pianist, composer and bandleader Ruben Hein. Widely praised for his warm and characteristic voice and his offbeat piano playing, Ruben Hein is the artistic director and conductor of the National Youth Jazz Orchestra (NJJO).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again
programme.desc: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again - the title says is all… After an automobile accident and 15 years of revalidation, he is back! Together with his musical pals Edwin Corzilius (double bass) and Frits Landesbergen (drums), pianist and composer Lex Jasper celebrates his return to jazz club The Duke in the Dutch village of Nistelrode.

programme.title: Teus Nobel live at the Bimhuis Amsterdam
programme.desc: Teus Nobel is a Dutch trumpet and flugelhorn player. As a little boy, he was inspired by ‘power’ trumpeters such as Maynard Ferguson and Bill Chase. While studying at the conservatory, he played both as jazz player and as a commercial session musician at musicals. After his time at the conservatory, he started playing in the Royal Netherlands Air Force Orchestra, playing march music influenced by pop and jazz.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sammy Price and his All Star Orchestra
programme.desc: Texan pianist Sammy Price (1908-1992) played everything from blues and boogie-woogie to swing and jump-blues. Starting in Dallas as a singer and dancer in Alphonso Trent’s orchestra, he went to Kansas to form the Texas Bluesicians. At the end of the 1930s, and as a house pianist for the Decca label, he backed many stars, including Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Trixie Smith.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: John Scofield - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: The last chieftain
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, Calypso
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Bill Evans - Maison de la Radio
programme.desc: Bill Evans is considered one of the greatest jazz pianists all time and is known for interpreting the jazz repertoire using impressionistic harmonies. In 1958, Evans first played in Miles Davis’s sextet recording the modal jazz album “Kind of Blue”, which is now considered one of the best jazz albums of all time. After leaving the ensemble, Evans formed several trios.

programme.title: Art Blakey Live in 1965
programme.desc: Art Blakey: Live in '65 features a very impressive lineup from jazz history: Art Blakey (drums), Jaki Byard (piano), Reggie Workman (bass), Nathan Davis (sax), and the legendary trumpet player, Freddie Hubbard. For a fall tour of Europe, Blakey assembled The New Jazzmen, a short-lived quintet that performed this legendary concert at La Mutualité in Paris on November 3, 1965.

programme.title: On The Road With Duke Ellington: II
programme.desc: In May 2014, the Conservatory of Amsterdam hosted a unique conference about one of the greatest jazz composers of the 20th century: Duke Ellington. Musicologists and musicians with a special bond with Ellington and his music spoke about his life and music. Among them were David Schiff, author of ‘The Ellington Century’, and Harvey Cohen, author of ‘Duke Ellington’s America’.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: The Flying Pickets - Don't Turn Around
programme.desc: The Flying Pickets are a British vocal group that was formed in 1982, transferring the art of a cappella to the pop music scene. These five gentlemen scored a number one hit in 1983 in the UK Singles Chart with their version of 'Only You'. Performing live in Stuttgart, vocalists Hereward Kaye, Gary Howard, Michael Henry, Nick Godfrey and Ricky Payne have many surprises in store for their appreciative audience.

programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: Ramón Valle And Reinier Baas - Music Meeting 2020
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. Disrupted by COVID-19, the festival’s 2020 edition had to adapt to new challenges.

programme.title: Under the Surface - Live at Bimhuis 2018
programme.desc: Under the Surface is an improvisational jazz band formed by drummer Joost Lijbaart, vocalist Sanne Rambags, and guitarist Bram Stadhouders. Sanne Rambags, the youngest artist of the trio, is one of the few vocalists of her generation who able to improvise effortlessly, be it by using her voice as an instrument blending with the sounds of the band, or by performing her own poetry.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Harmen Fraanje
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan And Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in ’s-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: TorTube: Robin Nolan Trio - Swing de Paris
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: Ray Charles - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, smooth jazz saxophonist and crowd-favorite Kenny G serenaded those attending the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Seven Eleven: Back to the Source
programme.desc: Dutch band Seven Eleven is a mix of funk, jazz and hip hop. Founded in 1987, Seven Eleven is one of the first Dutch bands to perform with rappers, having collaborated with hip hop crew Dope Posse in 1990. Adding a superb horn section to the original line-up, they were awarded the 1993 Camelpop Award.

programme.title: Paolo Tomelleri
programme.desc: Highly acclaimed Italian clarinetist, saxophonist, and bandleader Paolo Tomelleri (1938) is a European master of traditional jazz and swing. With his Big Band, he performs updated recreations of classic swing-era charts made famous by the likes of Benny Goodman and Count Basie.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Richard Bona
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Hi-Fi-Fo-Fum
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Things to Come
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Barbara
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: Basin Street Blues
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: Hercules Gomes - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist Hércules Gomes.

programme.title: Live at Bimhuis Amsterdam
programme.desc: Dutch free jazz, jazz rock, and electronic music pioneer Pierre Courbois threw a belated 80th birthday bash at Amsterdam’s renowned BIMhuis in January 2022. Courbois, a celebrated drummer and percussionist, also masters the tabla, conga, bass guitar, and vibraphone, and is a prolific writer with over 100 compositions to his credit.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: Scott DuBois Quartet Live In Munich
programme.desc: Rising star of the jazz guitar Scott DuBois leads his quartet, consisting of Gebhard Ullmann (reeds), Thomas Morgan (bass), and Kresten Osgood (drums), in an intimate and atmospheric performance at Munich’s Jazz Club Unterfahrt in March 2016. The group’s telepathy is such that they are able to go from deathly quiet to fiercely avant-garde at the drop of a hat.

programme.title: Birdlike
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Since You're Gone
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Tim Kliphuis and the NCO: The Changing Seasons
programme.desc: The Netherlands Chamber Orchestra commissioned violinist Tim Kliphuis, internationally known for his genre-crossing approach to music, to write a new version of Antonio Vivaldi's ‘Four Seasons’. Kliphuis choose to take improvisation as his starting point; at the same time, he intended to leave the best-known Vivaldi themes and chords in, as they give the piece its wonderful energy.

programme.title: Archie Shepp All Star - Tribute to John Coltrane
programme.desc: In 1960, Archie Shepp attended a concert of John Coltrane at the Five Spot, legendary club of the Lower East Side. Fascinated, he quickly decided to devote himself to the tenor saxophone. Five years later, Shepp - already a staple of free jazz - finally recorded alongside his idol. The result, published in 1966, is called Ascension and still remains today a symbol of free improvisation.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Sven Hammond Soul
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Jazzed Out London
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth’ trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: MEGA Fights In 60 T1 - Ep. 28
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features a Light Heavyweight Unification battle as WBO Champion Jean Pascal (25-1, 16 KOs) takes on undefeated IBO Champion, Chad Dawson, (29-0, 17 KOs) on August 14, 2010 at the Bell Centre in Montreal, Quebec, Canada.

programme.title: Mega Fights In 60 T1 - Ep. 29
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features a Super Welterweight, 10 Round contest featuring Joel Julio (34-2, 31 KOs) vs.undefeated James Kirkland, aka 'Mandingo Warrior' (24-0, 21 KOs) from the HP Pavilion in San Jose, California, USA on March 3, 2009.

programme.title: Fight Quest T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Episode 8: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - Hosts Jimmy Smith and Doug Anderson learn the Fight Discipline of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and the Martial Art of Grappling with Masters Renato Barreto and Breno Sivak.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 23
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is the second encounter between middleweights Paul Williams and Sergio Martinez. This time around, championship gold is on the line in a bout that will not go the distance. Also on the card, Marcos Maidana tries to jump up a weight class.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T32 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 1 from Dolphins Arena in Nagoya, Japan features Takarafuji, Ichinojo, Shimanoumi and Kiribayama.

programme.title: Macho: The Hector Camacho Story T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: This series takes a hard-hitting look at the rise, fall and untimely death of one of boxing's most colorful champions. Hector Camacho's dynamic speed, footwork and power made him a fighter to be reckoned with, but it was his flamboyance and showmanship that ushered in a new era in boxing.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Fights T1995 - Ep. 114
programme.desc: FIGHT SPORTS revisits some of Hector Camacho's best fights from the legendary USA's Tuesday Night Fights series alongside our new documentary series Macho: The Hector Camacho Story. In this episode Hector 'Macho' Camacho (47-3-0 21 KO) faces Todd Foster (33-3-0 29 KO) in a 12-round contest for the vacant IBC Welterweight Title from Atlantic City New Jersey USA.

programme.title: FS MMA T4 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: BodogFIGHT features classic MMA matches involving some of your favorite fighters! Female fighter Carina 'Barbie' Damm battles all three rounds against Molly 'The Maulinator' Helsel in Costa Rica.

programme.title: Les Invisibles
programme.desc: Un squelette est retrouvé dans le jardin d’une maison. La nouvelle propriétaire est sous le choc. Rapidement, l’équipe des Invisibles soupçonne le neveu de l’ancien propriétaire, qui a repris la maison au moment de la mort de ce dernier. Enzo, tout juste sorti de prison, semble avoir une idée bien précise en tête. Il se rapproche de cette jeune femme qui chante dans la rue, et use de ses charmes pour l’attirer dans ce qui ressemble à...

programme.title: Les Invisibles
programme.desc: Pour marquer l'inauguration de ses nouveaux locaux dont la construction vient de s'achever, un directeur de camp de vacances choisit d'organiser une fête où le point d'orgue sera la démolition symbolique des murs des anciens bâtiments. Une fois à l'oeuvre, les amis ne tardent pas à faire une terrible découverte : un corps se cache parmi les débris...

programme.title: Islam 2026
programme.desc: Avant d’être le Prophète de l’islam, Mohammed est un homme parmi les hommes. Orphelin dès son plus jeune âge, il grandit dans une société marquée par les solidarités tribales, le commerce et les inégalités. Connu pour son intégrité et son honnêteté, il reçoit le surnom d’Al-Amîn, « le digne de confiance ». Cette émission propose de découvrir l’homme derrière le messager : son caractère, ses relations, son quotidien, son goût pour la...

programme.title: A l'origine
programme.desc: Grâce aux technologies modernes nos sociétés occidentales nous ont amené un sentiment de confort et d’évolution. Mais est-ce que ce confort nous rend vraiment heureux ? Les réseaux sociaux, les changements de modèle familial, la perte des rituels religieux sont autant de signaux d’alerte sur une société en danger. Dans son dernier livre « Au saccage des petits bonheurs » aux Editions Odile Jacob, Boris Cyrulnik, neuropsychiatre, dresse...

programme.title: Ça Commence aujourd'hui
programme.desc: Tous les jours, Faustine BOLLAERT accueille sur le plateau de « Ca commence aujourd’hui » des hommes et des femmes qui viennent témoigner sur une période de leur vie, un drame, une épreuve, un cap à passer ou un changement, et qui font souvent écho à de grands sujets de société. Entourée d'experts : psychologues, psychiatres, avocats, gynécologue, Faustine aide les témoins et les téléspectateurs à mieux comprendre ce qu’ils ont vécu.

L'homme s'appelle Robert Lanski et était déjà responsable d'un accident ferroviaire qui avait coûté la vie à un adolescent, cinq ans auparavant. Les enquêteurs cherchent à savoir s'il s'agit d'une vengeance. Le Capitaine Marleau soupçonne le prêtre Damien, qui aurait de bonnes raisons d'en vouloir à Lanski. L'homme semble en savoir davantage que ce qu'il prétend et connaît tous...

programme.title: On the Case with Paula Zahn T14 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: A polícia tenta resolver um homicídio cruel, até perceber que a resposta para o mistério está escondida à vista de todos.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Siga verdadeiras investigações através das câmaras pessoais de agentes de vários departamentos dos EUA e assista às reviravoltas que levam à prisão de assassinos.

programme.title: Nightmare Next Door T3 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Quando Alan, um magnata do imobiliário, é morto na sua mansão, tudo parece indicar um roubo violento. Mas os detectives não tardam a suspeitar da ex-mulher amargurada.

programme.title: Crime Scene Confidential T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A CSI, Alina Burroughs viaja até à zona rural do Ohio para investigar o homicídio de Margie Coffey, em 1988, mãe solteira, estrangulada e cujo corpo foi largado num riacho gelado.

programme.title: Crime Scene Confidential T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A CSI, Alina Burroughs viaja até ao Arizona para investigar o homicídio de Kim Ancona. Reabre o caso para descobrir se uma marca de mordidela é suficiente para provar um homicídio.

programme.title: Murder Under The Friday Night Lights T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Quando uma jovem líder de claque desaparece subitamente, a polícia interroga a equipa de futebol e a claque. A verdade sinistra choca a pequena cidade de Great Bend, no Kansas.

programme.title: Murder Under The Friday Night Lights T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Tristan Dilley é assassinado na noite a seguir ao baile de finalistas, mas com tanta gente de regresso à cidade para o baile, a polícia tem dificuldade em identificar um suspeito.

programme.title: Undercover Underage T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Flori é alvo de um alegado rapaz de 17 anos, interessado nela para pornografia infantil. Após o desaparecimento dele, é abordada por um homem com táticas suspeitas semelhantes.

programme.title: Undercover Underage T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Roo e a equipa colocam duas menores de idade sob disfarce. Depois do contacto com dois adultos sexualmente agressivos, um erro coloca uma das investigações em risco.

programme.title: Nightmare Next Door T3 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Quando Alan, um magnata do imobiliário, é morto na sua mansão, tudo parece indicar um roubo violento. Mas os detectives não tardam a suspeitar da ex-mulher amargurada.

programme.title: Nightmare Next Door T3 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Crystal é raptada, violada e estrangulada, quando ia para a casa de uma amiga. Um ano depois, outra jovem é assassinada. Tudo indica a presença de um serial killer.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes T5 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Um familiar encontra Cindy Testerman estrangulada na sua própria casa. Uma segunda mulher desaparece e a polícia apressa-se para apanhar o responsável.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes T5 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: A polícia do Texas investiga a morte a tiro de José Armando Pina, de 23 anos. Um agressor mascarado foge do local do crime e deixa para trás provas fundamentais.

programme.title: Border Control: Spain T4 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Acompanhe as intervenções dos serviços de segurança aduaneira nas fronteiras de Espanha, que estão sobre constante ameaça de traficantes de drogas, armas e terroristas.

programme.title: Border Control: Spain T5 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Siga a atividade dos agentes dos serviços de segurança aduaneira das fronteiras espanholas, que combatem o tráfico de armas e drogas e vigiam a atividade terrorista.

programme.title: Border Control: Spain T4 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Acompanhe as intervenções dos serviços de segurança aduaneira nas fronteiras de Espanha, que estão sobre constante ameaça de traficantes de drogas, armas e terroristas.

programme.title: Border Control: Spain T5 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Siga a atividade dos agentes dos serviços de segurança aduaneira das fronteiras espanholas, que combatem o tráfico de armas e drogas e vigiam a atividade terrorista.

programme.title: Someone You Thought You Knew T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Chris Northam, um empreendedor do mundo do desporto da Califórnia, é alvejado no interior do seu armazém. Os seus empregados e a sua amante são os principais suspeitos.

programme.title: Someone You Thought You Knew T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Bill e Mary Yoder são um casal feliz que tem um negócio próspero. Mas quando Mary adoece misteriosamente, os detectives não crêem que isso tenho acontecido por acidente.

programme.title: The Killer Beside Me T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Bob Peterson faz-se convidado da festa de inauguração da casa nova dos seus colegas Gene e Jaye-Jaye Thurnau. Jaye-Jaye sai e quando volta Gene e Bob estão desaparecidos.

programme.title: The Killer Beside Me T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Quando Andrea Farrington conhece Alex Kozak, fica a pensar que o romance é uma possibilidade. Mas as suspeitas e o medo levam a um rejeição com consequências fatais.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Investigação criminal feita a partir das câmaras dos agentes da Polícia espalhados pelos EUA. Conheça as reviravoltas dramáticas levam à captura de um assassino.

programme.title: The Face Of Evil T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Quando Sonya Ivanoff é encontrada morta a tiro perto da remota localidade de Nome, no Alasca, os detectives recorrem à ciência forense para apanhar o seu assassino.

programme.title: The Face Of Evil T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: O desaparecimento de uma menina numa pequena localidade leva a Polícia a procurar suspeitos nas imediações. Uma informação e a ciência expõem um amigo com um segredo.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving A Serial Killer T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Vários rapazes encontram-se com o assassino em série John Wayne Gacy em Chicago nos anos 50 e 70, mas conseguem sobreviver.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: A mãe adolescente, Cheyenne, encontra aceitação num grupo e vai viver com duas raparigas e os namorados destas, mas após encontrar o seu namorado, a desconfiança leva à morte.

programme.title: Gemini 8
programme.desc: Gemini 8 é uma série animada que narra as aventuras de Marco, um garoto terrestre que, ao ser puxado por uma pipa através de um portal, é transportado para o distante planeta Gemini 8. Apresenta uma mistura de aventura e ficção científica, explorando temas como amizade, exploração e o desconhecido.

programme.title: Diário De Mika

programme.title: Les Amateurs
programme.desc: Sur le chemin du travail après une soirée arrosée, Vincent, la trentaine, est témoin d'un accident de voiture et découvre le téléphone du blessé. Lorsqu'il répond à un appel, il entend des hurlements de femme, et une voix menaçante : « Si vous n’êtes pas là à 17h, nous tuerons votre femme ». Alban, son collègue de 45 ans, au tempérament fougueux, se voit déjà en héros du jour et pousse Vincent à l’action.

programme.title: Les Amateurs
programme.desc: Dans une prison marocaine, Vincent et Alban risquent la mort s’ils n’exécutent pas une mission périlleuse : trouver où l’un de leurs codétenus, Attila, un psychopathe sanguinaire, a caché une cargaison de drogues. Alors que Noël approche et qu’ils brûlent de rentrer chez eux pour retrouver leurs proches, la situation semble désespérée.

programme.title: Cauchemar En Cuisine
programme.desc: Philippe Etchebest se rend dans les Bouches-du-Rhône, à Sénas, où Mélanie et Mylène, deux jumelles de 28 ans, ont fait appel à lui pour sauver le restaurant qu'elles gèrent avec leur grande sœur Séverine. Bien qu'il soit placé au centre du village et entouré de nombreux commerces, les clients ont déserté leur établissement. Rien d'étonnant à cela puisque, dès son arrivée, le chef a vite été plongé dans l'ambiance glaciale qui règne...

programme.title: Cauchemar En Cuisine

programme.title: Scènes De Ménages
programme.desc: Votre couple vous désole ? Vous vous lamentez de vivre seul ? Scènes de Ménages va vous aider à relativiser !

programme.title: Arnaques!
programme.desc: Les drôles de méthodes de Mister menuiserie Avec plus d’une centaine de magasins en France et 70 millions d'euros de chiffre d’affaires, l’enseigne, spécialiste des portails et fenêtres, avait tout pour rassurer ses clients. Mais, du jour au lendemain, rideau. Portails, pergolas, volets : des commandes à 5 000, 10 000, 20 000 euros payées, jamais livrées. Remises mirobolantes, ventes forcées, mensonges en série : d'anciens vendeurs...

programme.title: Arnaques!
programme.desc: Dans le sud, deux femmes auraient arnaqué plus de 300 personnes Derrière les promesses de voyages de rêve à prix cassés se cachent parfois de véritables escroqueries. C'est le cas de plus de 300 clients qui pensaient avoir réservé leurs vacances auprès d'une plateforme spécialisée. À la clé : des séjours annulés, des économies envolées et près de 1,5 million d'euros de préjudice. Aujourd'hui, l'une des dirigeantes a disparu. Les...
